statement: The function returns a result r. Call a set S of ordered pairs (i,d) with i,d integers a feasible eating plan if: (1) every pair in S has 0 <= i < n and d >= 0; (2) i <= d < i + days[i] for every (i,d) in S; (3) for every i, the number of pairs in S whose first component is i is at most apples[i]; and (4) the second components d of all pairs in S are pairwise distinct. Then r is the maximum of |S| over all feasible eating plans S.
preconditions: Let n = len(apples). Assume len(apples) = len(days) = n, 1 <= n <= 20000, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= apples[i] <= 20000, 0 <= days[i] <= 20000, and days[i] = 0 if and only if apples[i] = 0. All indices and array lengths are mathematical integers; the i64 inputs are taken at their integer values.
